teacher_target_construction.name: rich_value_visible_reference

teacher_target_construction.name: block_blind_teacher

teacher_target_construction.name: residual_diagnostic_teacher

teacher_topology.name: shared_ema_backbone_typed_heads

teacher_topology.name: independent_complementary_teacher_team

teacher_topology.name: rna_teacher_plus_privileged_auxiliary_critics

student_topology.name: core_plus_specialist_students
student_topology.activation_rule: Only after measured negative transfer/interference in the shared student. Historical rare-specialist/graph lineages did not earn default status.
